hooks.command: if [ -n "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" ]; then _in="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; elif [ ! -t 0 ]; then _in=""; while IFS= read -r _l || [ -n "$_l" ]; do _in="$_in$_l"; done; else _in=""; fi; case "$_in" in *'"file_path"'*) _t="${_in#*\"file_path\"}"; _t="${_t#*\"}"; _f="${_t%%\"*}";; *) _f="";; esac; case "$_f" in *.env|*.env.*) printf 'BLOCKED: refusing to modify %s - .env holds real secrets. Edit .env.example instead.\n' "$_f" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
